info.name: HustleHub Marketplace & Security
info.description: End-to-end marketplace and access-control checks. Use disposable data; creates random test accounts. The npm test:api runner provisions an isolated HTTPS instance and removes all test data.

exec: pm.test('No stack traces or password hashes in responses', () => { const body = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(body).not.to.include('passwordHash'); pm.expect(body).not.to.include('Error:'); });

exec: pm.test("Transaction is linked to booking and correct participants", () => { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.transaction.bookingId).to.eql(d.booking.id); pm.expect(d.booking.clientId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('clientId')); pm.expect(d.transaction.freelancerId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('ownerId')); pm.expect(d.transaction.amountCents).to.eql(250050); pm.expect(d.transaction.status).to.eql('simulated'); pm.expect(d.booking).not.to.have.property('idempotencyKey'); });

item.name: Reject reusing confirmation for another gig
Owner income is credited exactly once

exec: pm.test('20% tax estimate and monthly totals match owner income', () => { const i=pm.response.json().insights; pm.expect(i.incomeCents).to.eql(250050); pm.expect(i.taxCents).to.eql(50010); pm.expect(i.netCents).to.eql(200040); pm.expect(i.months).to.have.lengthOf(12); pm.expect(i.months.reduce((n,m)=>n+m.taxCents,0)).to.eql(i.taxCents); });
